_note: GST rule pack (I5): the composition scheme's limits and what its bills must say (s. 10; Rule 7).

entries.legend: composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies

explain.en: A business may be under composition up to ₹1.5 crore turnover (₹75 lakh in the special-category States), or ₹50 lakh for services; it cannot collect tax from customers and issues bills of supply with the composition legend; and it may not supply to another State (s. 10(2)(c), 10(2A)).
explain.hi-Latn: Composition scheme ₹1.5 crore turnover tak (khaas States mein ₹75 lakh), service ke liye ₹50 lakh; customer se tax nahi le sakte; bill of supply par composition wali line likhi hoti hai; doosre State mein supply nahi kar sakte.
